title: Enterprise Connectivity: monthly aggregate export scope
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this monthly aggregate export scope rule to corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Basis: volume
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, for the selected unresolved monthly-aggregate rate-error review, sum posted primary internet outbound transfer meter volume on this holding in the original charge's source billing month; cancelled exports, supplemental meters and other periods are excluded.

## Basis Q&A
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Corrected monthly transfer assessment: For the selected unresolved monthly-aggregate rate-error review, sum posted primary internet outbound transfer meter volume on this holding in the original charge's source billing month | cancelled exports, supplemental meters and other periods are excluded. |

## Hypothetical export selection
For a hypothetical monthly-aggregate correction review, two different posted primary internet outbound exports on the same holding in the original charge’s month both contribute their measured volume. A cancelled export, an ancillary meter or an export in another month contributes none. A legacy reference to one contributing export does not narrow this monthly sum.
